query: What is the structure of the Horizon Europe programme?
response:
Horizon Europe (2021-2027) is the EU's key funding programme for research and innovation, structured around three main Pillars, supported by a cross-cutting component on Widening Participation and Strengthening the European Research Area (ERA). The total budget is **€95.5 billion**.

### The Three Pillars of Horizon Europe

#### Pillar 1: Excellent Science
This pillar supports frontier research and world-class researchers, focusing on building capacity and quality in the European science base. It operates predominantly on a bottom-up basis, meaning researchers propose their own topics.

| Component | Focus |
|---|---|
| **European Research Council (ERC)** | Funding for individual excellent researchers (Starting, Consolidator, Advanced Grants) to pursue frontier research. |
| **Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)** | Funding for researcher mobility, training, and career development. |
| **Research Infrastructures** | Funding to develop, consolidate, and offer access to world-class research facilities. |

#### Pillar 2: Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness
This is the largest pillar, focusing on research and innovation that addresses major societal challenges and strengthens key European industrial technologies. It operates through targeted calls defined in Work Programmes, grouped into six thematic Clusters.

| Cluster | Key Focus Areas |
|---|---|
| **Cluster 1: Health** | Health promotion, disease prevention, diagnostics, and innovative healthcare. |
| **Cluster 2: Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society** | Democratic governance, cultural heritage, and socio-economic transformation. |
| **Cluster 3: Civil Security for Society** | Disaster resilience, border management, cybersecurity, and fighting crime and terrorism. |
| **Cluster 4: Digital, Industry and Space** | Digital technologies (AI, data, robotics), advanced materials, manufacturing, and space technologies. |
| **Cluster 5: Climate, Energy and Mobility** | Climate action, renewable energy, energy efficiency, clean transport, and smart cities. |
| **Cluster 6: Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture and Environment** | Sustainable food systems, biodiversity, circular economy, and environmental monitoring. |

#### Pillar 3: Innovative Europe
This pillar aims to boost disruptive and market-creating innovation, particularly by supporting SMEs and high-risk, high-impact projects.

| Component | Focus |
|---|---|
| **European Innovation Council (EIC)** | Supports market-creating innovation, primarily via the EIC Accelerator (for individual SMEs), EIC Pathfinder (for early-stage technologies), and EIC Transition (to turn research results into innovation opportunities). |
| **European Innovation Ecosystems** | Networking and strengthening regional and national innovation systems. |
| **European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT)** | Integrating business, research, and education through Knowledge and Innovation Communities (KICs). |

### Cross-Cutting Component: Widening Participation and Strengthening ERA
This component aims to reduce the R&I gap across Europe, promoting excellence in less R&I-performing Member States and Associated Countries, and reforming the European research landscape (e.g., policy support, gender equality plans).

***

### Next Steps: Actionable Guidance

To find opportunities within this structure, use these official resources:

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for your cluster
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
